te: Review of committee positions, the Chanthaburi study visit, and excise tax on fragrance concentrates
se: The committee reviewed its positions and resolved that Mr. Wiwat Kraiphisitkul continues as chairperson. It noted the work of the subcommittee on commerce and the digital economy, including its visit to Chanthaburi (21–22 Mar 2026), and considered a complaint asking for a review of the excise tax on fragrance concentrates, which the complainant says affects the Thai cosmetics industry; the agencies concerned will be invited to give information.
it: Review of positions in the committee (chairperson, vice-chairpersons, secretary and others)
Subcommittee on commerce and the digital economy: progress and Chanthaburi study visit
Complaint asking for a review of the excise tax on fragrance concentrates (effects on the cosmetics industry, as the complainant says)

te: Complaint about fly ash transport in Nan, and progress of the coconut price working group
se: The committee noted the work of the subcommittees and of the working group on low coconut prices, then considered the complaint about fly ash transport, hearing the complainants, the Department of Industrial Works and Nan provincial officials. The main issue was the safety of transporting risky materials on mountain roads.
it: Work of the subcommittees (border trade and community enterprises · industry and special economic zones · commerce and the digital economy) and the working group on low coconut prices
Complaint about the effects of fly ash transport (complainants, Department of Industrial Works and Nan provincial officials invited)

te: Report on border community enterprises, odour-measuring technology, Thai SELECT, and a complaint about fly ash transport
se: The committee noted progress on the report about community enterprises in border special economic zones, work on using odour-measuring technology (E-Nose) to help oversee factories, and the study of the Thai SELECT project. It then considered a complaint from citizens who say they are affected by the transport of fly ash, and agreed to invite those involved to give information at the next meeting.
it: Work of the subcommittees (border trade and community enterprises · industry and special economic zones · commerce and the digital economy)
Complaint from citizens who say they are affected by the transport of fly ash

te: Work of 3 subcommittees: community enterprises, coconuts, the Thai SELECT mark and durians
se: The committee noted the work of 3 subcommittees: border trade and community enterprises (heard agencies of the Ministry of Commerce), industry and special economic zones (a visit on the health industry and community economy, and proposals on coconut prices), and commerce and the digital economy (a visit to restaurants holding the Thai SELECT mark in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, and the durian situation).
it: Work of the subcommittees (border trade and community enterprises · industry and special economic zones · commerce and the digital economy)
Visit to restaurants holding the Thai SELECT mark, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya (19 Feb 2026)
Suggestions on solving low coconut prices

te: Southern study visit, problems of Thai durians, and solving low coconut prices
se: The committee noted the visit of the subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises to Phatthalung, Yala and Songkhla (12–14 Feb 2026), and the work of the subcommittee on commerce and the digital economy on growing, selling and exporting durians, which proposed a central data and traceability system, processing of lower-grade durians and oversight of possible nominee arrangements. It then considered ways to solve low coconut prices, following the earlier complaint.
it: Subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises: study visit to Phatthalung, Yala and Songkhla
Subcommittee on commerce and the digital economy: Thai durian situation and proposals (traceability, processing, oversight of nominees)
Ways to solve low coconut prices (following the farmers' complaint)

te: Work of the subcommittees, and matters from the senators-meet-the-people programme in Ratchaburi
se: Meeting on Wednesday 11 February 2026, according to the meeting notice: the agenda covered the work of the subcommittees and the complaints and suggestions received at the senators-meet-the-people programme for the lower central region in Ratchaburi province. (the summary file published by the Senate is an image; please read the details in the original document below)
it: Work of the subcommittees
Complaints and suggestions from the senators-meet-the-people programme, lower central region, Ratchaburi province

te: Special economic zones: the Thai Canal and herbal industry case studies, and a complaint about eastern durians
se: The committee noted the work of the subcommittee on industry and special economic zones, which heard the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council and set up two working groups: the Thai Canal special economic area (studied as a case in many dimensions, not only digging a canal) and the herbal and comprehensive medical industry. It then considered a complaint from citizens in Chanthaburi about durians in the eastern region, such as moving the "fruit metropolis" strategy forward and registering a geographical indication (GI).
it: Subcommittee on industry and special economic zones: working groups on the Thai Canal special economic area and on the herbal and medical industry
Complaint from citizens: eastern durians in the 2026 season (fruit metropolis strategy, GI registration, financing and price stability)

te: Border trade and community enterprises, the Chiang Rai study visit, and a plan for special economic zones
se: The committee noted the work of the subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises, which drafted the outline of its study report, invited community-development and agriculture agencies to give information and reported on its visit to Chiang Rai (19–20 Jan 2026). It also noted the subcommittee on industry and special economic zones, which is setting a framework for developing special economic zones.
it: Subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises: report outline, agencies invited, Chiang Rai study visit
Subcommittee on industry and special economic zones: framework for developing special economic zones
Request from an outside organisation for support of a seminar

te: Starting 2026: border trade study visits, a complaint on low coconut prices, and a seminar on the Chinese market
se: At the first meeting of 2026 (7 Jan 2026) the committee noted the work plan of the subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises and its study visits to several provinces (Chiang Rai, Phetchaburi, Kanchanaburi, Nong Khai, Bueng Kan, Tak, Songkhla, Yala). It considered a complaint from a farmers' network about very low prices of aromatic coconuts and claims that coconut water was being adulterated, and a seminar project on entering the Chinese market through online trade and lowering production costs.
it: Subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises: work plan and study visits
Complaint from a farmers' network: low coconut prices and claims of adulterated coconut water
Seminar project "Entering the Chinese market with online trade and Lean systems" to help Thai businesses compete
